result.summary: Prepared DB migration plan (5 steps, 4 scripts) legacy_db -> target_db

output.migration_summary: The migration involves modernizing a legacy VB6 banking application to a C# modular monolith, with a focus on translating VB6 forms to C#, replacing ActiveX controls, and implementing a service-oriented architecture. The database will be migrated to SQL Server with enhancements for Docker-based deployment.

risk_notes: The legacy database schema is not provided, which may introduce risks in identifying necessary schema changes.
Ensure backward compatibility with existing data and interfaces.

migration_plan.description: Perform a thorough analysis of the legacy database schema to identify tables, indexes, and constraints.
Design the target SQL Server schema based on the analysis and modernization requirements.
Create scripts to migrate data from the legacy database to the new SQL Server schema.
Conduct tests to ensure data integrity and application functionality post-migration.
Execute the migration in the production environment, ensuring minimal downtime.

generated_scripts.name: CreateTargetSchema
generated_scripts.sql: CREATE TABLE ExampleTable (ID INT PRIMARY KEY, Name NVARCHAR(100), CreatedDate DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE());

generated_scripts.name: MigrateData
generated_scripts.sql: INSERT INTO ExampleTable (ID, Name) SELECT ID, Name FROM LegacyTable;

generated_scripts.name: ValidateDataIntegrity
generated_scripts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ExampleTable WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM LegacyTable);

generated_scripts.name: RollbackMigration
generated_scripts.sql: DELETE FROM ExampleTable WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM LegacyTable);

data_validation_checks: Verify row counts between legacy and target tables match.
Check for data type mismatches and truncations.
Ensure all foreign key relationships are maintained.
output.rollback_strategy: In case of failure, execute the RollbackMigration script to revert changes and restore the database to its pre-migration state.
